en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Usman Bin Isa, from Khalid Bin Najeeh, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Al-Suweyq is a meal of the Mursil Prophets<sup>as</sup>’, or said: ‘The Prophets<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bandar has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa Khalid ibn Najih who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
sawiq is the food of the messengers’ or he (the Imam) said, ‘the food of the Prophets.’”
